auth: OAuth2 client-credentials via PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET/PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT (token auto-managed by SDK)
constraints: External info sourced only from developer.paypal.com + local SDK type defs; no MCP tools; one use case at a time; tsc self-test each step
summary: Implemented all 8 PayPal use cases as a self-contained Vendure plugin. Each use case compiled cleanly (tsc exit 0) and was handed off for manual GraphQL-playground verification.

title: Standard Checkout (immediate capture)
mechanism: PaymentMethodHandler.createPayment captures an approved PayPal order; settlePayment is a no-op. Shop mutation createPayPalCheckout creates a CAPTURE-intent order and returns the approval URL.
verification: Order -> PaymentSettled, payment Settled, transactionId=captureId, metadata.status=COMPLETED

title: Approval page spins indefinitely after Pay Now
root_cause: Missing return_url in the deprecated application_context block; PayPal had nowhere to redirect the buyer after approval.
fix: Switched to payment_source.paypal.experience_context with always-present returnUrl/cancelUrl (plus a warning when absent); set reachable default return/cancel URLs in dev-config.ts.

title: Authorize-then-Capture
mechanism: createPayPalCheckout gains intent (CAPTURE|AUTHORIZE). Handler reads the order intent back from PayPal: AUTHORIZE -> createPayment authorizes (Authorized state, stores authorizationId); settlePayment captures the authorization. CAPTURE keeps UC1 behavior.
verification: addPaymentToOrder -> PaymentAuthorized; admin settlePayment -> Settled, metadata.captureId set

title: Payment Cancellation / Void
mechanism: Handler cancelPayment voids an uncaptured authorization (PaymentsController.voidPayment). Captured payments return a clear error directing to refund; payments with no authorization succeed as no-op.
verification: Admin cancelPayment on an Authorized payment -> Cancelled, metadata.status=VOIDED; negative: void of captured payment is rejected

title: Full Refund
mechanism: Handler createRefund refunds a captured payment; full refund omits the amount. Maps PayPal refund status to Vendure RefundState.
verification: Admin refundOrder with full amount -> Refund Settled, metadata.refundId set

title: Refund returns 422
root_cause: PayPal rejected the refund with a specific issue code (commonly REFUND_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS in sandbox); the error handler was discarding the reason and only surfacing the HTTP status.
fix: Added describePayPalError + readBodyField and rewired toReadablePayPalError to extract name/details[].issue/description/debug_id from result or raw body. The refund call itself was correctly formed; the 422 is a sandbox business-account balance condition resolved by funding the business account.

title: Partial Refund
mechanism: Same createRefund path: when requested amount < payment total, the explicit amount is sent (partial). PayPal allows multiple partials per capture, each bounded by Vendure to the remaining refundable balance. Added a non-positive-amount guard and clearer logging.
verification: Two successive partial refundOrder calls on one capture -> two Settled Refunds with distinct refundIds

title: Subscription Billing (recurring)
mechanism: Dedicated module: PayPalSubscription entity (local mirror), service wrapping SubscriptionsController for billing-plan + subscription lifecycle, admin+shop GraphQL resolvers, and an hourly ScheduledTask that reconciles subscription status. Subscription status is read from the raw response body because the SDK's Subscription model strips the status field.
prereq: A PayPal Catalog Product id (created once via the Catalog Products REST API; SDK has no products controller).
verification: createPayPalBillingPlan (ACTIVE) -> createPayPalSubscription (approval URL) -> approve -> syncPayPalSubscription returns ACTIVE -> cancel/capture/update management
self_test: tsc exit 0; full dev-server typecheck clean

title: Transaction Reporting
mechanism: Reporting module (no entities) proxying TransactionSearchController. searchTransactions auto-splits arbitrary ranges into <=31-day windows, stitches and paginates them (bounded by MAX_WINDOWS with truncated flag + warning). getBalances proxies account balances.
prereq: Transaction Search feature enabled on the PayPal REST app; ~3-hour reporting delay (reconciliation, not real-time).
verification: payPalTransactions over a >31-day range returns stitched results (truncated=false); payPalBalances returns business-account balances
self_test: tsc exit 0; full dev-server typecheck clean

title: Order Shipment Tracking
mechanism: Fulfillment hook (no endpoints/entities): on FulfillmentStateTransitionEvent to Shipped (or Delivered), resolve the order(s), read PayPal payment metadata (paypalOrderId+captureId), and push carrier+tracking via OrdersController.createOrderTracking (notifyPayer=true). Carrier mapped to ShipmentCarrier enum, else OTHER+carrierNameOther.
verification: addFulfillmentToOrder(manual-fulfillment, method+trackingCode) -> transitionFulfillmentToState Shipped -> tracking appears on the PayPal capture; buyer notified
self_test: tsc exit 0; full dev-server typecheck clean

architecture.subscription_module: UC6 via standalone NestJS module (entity+service+resolvers+scheduled task)
architecture.reporting_module: UC7 via admin API resolvers proxying PayPal (no entities)

known_env_prereqs: Fund sandbox business account for refunds (UC4/UC5)
Enable Transaction Search on the app (UC7)
Create a Catalog Product for billing plans (UC6)
pre_existing_unrelated_errors: packages/dev-server/load-testing/benchmarks.ts commander typings (not introduced by this work)
